clips.title: The story
paras: Remnants of War tasks adventurers with recovering shattered shards of the necrotic focusing crystal blown off Naxxramas during its assault on the Undercity. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn suffered heavy losses repelling the citadel, and gathering these dangerous fragments prevents Scourge cultists from reclaiming their dark magic.

Not long ago, the dread citadel Naxxramas loomed directly over Tirisfal Glades, seeking to wipe out the Undercity and erase the Forsaken entirely. In a desperate defense, the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn fought back the floating fortress at great cost. During the clash, the immense necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was destroyed, blasting fragments across the glades below.

Though the citadel was driven off, the fallout remains embedded in the soil. Scourge cultists have moved in to retrieve the necrotic crystal fragments, hoping to harness the dark magic still lingering inside them. Collecting these shards deprives the Scourge of raw unholy power, though clearing every piece from Tirisfal will take years.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
